name: Jiangsu Shuangxing Color Plastic New Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Shuangxing Color Plastic New Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of polymer composite products in China and internationally. The company offers optical substrates, including protective, optical film, MLCC, and energy-saving window film substrates; optical films, such as diffusion, prism, microporous, optical composite, protective, back coating, and others; and new energy materials comprising transparent reinforced backplane PET base, solar cell back material base, solar cell backplane, and PET composite copper foil films.
